candidates.change_summary: Delete the failure check so a failing call to the target no longer reverts and execution continues to transfer the balance to the owner.
Replace the transfer of the full balance to the owner with a transfer of zero, so the owner receives nothing after go().
Replace the value forwarded to the target with 1 wei instead of msg.value, changing how much Ether is sent onward.
Forward 0 value to the external target instead of msg.value.
Remove the revert on failed external call so failing calls no longer revert and funds stay in the contract.
Delete the final transfer to owner so the remaining balance is not swept out of the contract.
Sweep the remaining balance to the caller (msg.sender) instead of the stored owner.
Forward the entire contract balance to the target instead of only msg.value.
Delete the statement that forwards the remaining balance to the owner, leaving funds in the contract after go().
Forward 0 value to the target instead of msg.value, so the target receives no ether from the call.
Remove the revert on failure so a failed external call is ignored and execution continues.
Delete the revert on call failure so a failed external call no longer reverts.
Change the external call value from msg.value to 0 so the target receives no Ether.
Delete the statement that transfers the remaining balance back to the owner.
Remove the success check on the target call so failed calls no longer revert.
Change the payout from transfer of the full balance to a call forwarding the full balance.
Send the payout to msg.sender instead of owner.
Transfer 0 instead of the contract's full balance to the owner.
Remove the payout transfer to the owner entirely.
Delete the statement that transfers the remaining balance to the owner.
Forward zero value to the target instead of msg.value, leaving all sent funds for the owner transfer.
Move the owner transfer statement before the external call to the target.
Remove the revert on call failure so failed calls to target no longer cause the transaction to revert.
Send 0 instead of msg.value in the call to the target, so no ether is forwarded.
Delete the final transfer to the owner so the remaining balance is not swept out of the contract.
Invert the success check so any successful call to the target reverts.
Move the owner transfer before the target call so the target receives the fresh msg.value only and the pre-call balance goes to the owner.
Delete the `revert();` statement so a failed call to target no longer causes `go` to revert.
Replace the forwarded value `msg.value` with the contract's full balance when calling the target.
Delete the statement transferring the remaining balance to the owner, so no funds are swept to `owner`.
Move the owner transfer statement before the target call block so funds are swept to the owner before forwarding msg.value to the target.
